# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 17 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam Sends Seth for the Oil of Mercy

---

**1** Adam called Seth to him and said: 'My son Seth, go quickly to paradise, you and your mother Eve, and bring me a little of the oil of mercy from the tree of mercy, that I may be anointed and have relief from this pain.'

**2** Seth said to his father: 'Father, I do not know the way to paradise. I have not seen the way since we were expelled.'

**3** Adam said to him: 'Go to the east of paradise and you will find the footprints of your mother and me, for we walked there together. Follow our footprints and you will find the gate.'

**4** Seth rose and took his mother Eve by the hand and set off toward paradise.

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
